summary: Create immutable embed and stable release tags with lease-protected Git pushes, and pre-push the first rolling edge tag before creating its release.

replay.detail: No replay or persisted state behavior changes.

schema.detail: No storage schema or data migration changes.

rules.detail: Stable drafts remain untagged until exact-SHA product GO and artifact verification pass.

compatibility.detail: Release archive formats, runtime protocols and supported consumers are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: Publishers use the existing job token through Git authentication; no additional operator setup is required.

recovery.detail: An interrupted push-before-release can leave a correct immutable tag without a release; rerun the publisher to resume. Failed pushes accept a same-SHA winner, refuse a different SHA, and retry transient failures only while the tag remains absent.
